[*] [b]Eitr Enhancer[/b] changed from [b]common [/b]to [b]uncommon[/b].

notes.title: Update 1.0 : Valkyrie's Lament
notes.notes:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Welcome to [b]Roots of Yggdrasil 1.0[/b]!

This update contains new characters, buildings and over 100+ Changes and improvements! Over the course of Early Access, we've used your feedback to shape the game. We've added and reworked a lot of systems, but until now, most of the quests, characters and collection was left incomplete. This changes now as we tie up those loose ends today! We are very excited to bring you this massive update. Hope you enjoy it 🤗 

[previewyoutube=y96K5yRfNWM;full][/previewyoutube]

Before we go in-depth, here's is a quick recap of some of the biggest features added in this update.
[list]
[*] New Scion : The Valkyrie
[*] New Housing : Hall Houses
[*] New Adventures & Map events
[*] New Artifacts & Buildings
[*] A Conclusion to all the Quests!
[*] ...And much more!
[/list]

[h1]New Playable Scion : The Valkyrie[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/88c6c16d469ed8957305742a1a7c8ae0fc88cb20.png[/img]
Eir, our new Playable scion, is centered on Threats. It’s all about taking risks, creating danger in order to exploit it. Let’s look at her starting passives :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/db0564176f0df436a1df7eba92989828d549c921.png[/img]

War Cry gives might income per turn every time a Threat spawns. This helps dealing with most of them, which will trigger its second passive, gaining population when you spend might. With this, you can now see why spawning threats is interesting for Eir. This is why her active ability, Cursed Valkyrie, simply spawns a Threat on the map. But be careful, it could be a draugr camp, a storm or even a fire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/68c7f2eb12332f24ddd3be3ed39a46c99ee987de.gif[/img]

[h1]New Housing : Halls [/h1]
New Housing Type available : Great Halls and Hall Houses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9ce9e5d75852aeb7d05e4eea405a4ea91c0feeca.png[/img]

Great halls are expansive buildings that can be upgraded when placing housing near them. Hall houses are cheap, but do not give anything by themselves. Place them near Great Halls to obtain population. Each upgrade of the Great Hall gives an income of a different resource, so place your housing carefully!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/31e880831786d28980e2350e2cce779b9660632b.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/181f3c3685ac0849a27ac3e0216fa724ec5a576e.png[/img]
[h1]Buildings 🏭[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/c739c03176722aa089450b6075417770ca8d71ae.png[/img]
[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] With this update we're bringing many more deckbuilding options. Raiding camp allows you to keep threats around for a bonus if you can manage them. Lodging upgrade opens all kinds of possibilities with each housing type. Cart maker brings a new mechanic to the game by creating a zone around it that will allow you to draw cards when building in it.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0a6fe90c94f1c9ad846de9c88d9cc69113c25c9c.png[/img]
[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b]We also added more options to play with Eitr with the Eitr Transformer and Enhancers. This new guild will also work well with Eir's new powers focused on Threats. [/i]

[h1]Artifacts 💍[/h1]
You'll find new artifacts both in the default pool and some to unlock in the Greenhouse this patch. Take a look at some of them : 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9bdc859203450efd66e8b6eeeecded7839d12e30.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b4c1b9714223aa753ae5582256fe8307ada85775.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/366e3c780b0c255283aa2ff687098a7bfc442dba.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] This time again, our goal with artifacts is to allow new playstyles. Use [b]Living Brick[/b] to reduce the cost of your buildings and draft more. Skip those drafts to upgrade your deck using [b]Verdant Hoe[/b] or draft ephemeral cards to benefit from the bonus of [b]Mead of Poetry[/b] when they leave your deck. [/i]

There's some other artifacts as well, but we'll let you discover them yourselves!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/669d392ab45f347c7d7c39770239b840d5a69a9a.png[/img]

[h1]Events & Adventures[/h1]
[list][*] New Warden : Gerda
    [list]
    [*] The Last Jotun joins the adventure! Explore Asgard to meet our new warden. Gerda has her own story and events for you to discover![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/043e5df60e20a9bdd1cde90c947e60c78548889c.png[/img][/list]
[*] 3 New Adventures
    [list]
    [*] [b]Runic Forge[/b] : Transform your resources from a type to another![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d0ab0ae3fe18ed68f2d82c1a44dc7c416ad09d16.png[/img]
    [*] [b]Runic Stone[/b] : Add a keyword to a card.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7a5075b0db753b9b9c1df607def06891973eff74.png[/img]
    [*] [b]Runic Altar[/b] : Gain a Brittle Action card.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6c5a37e2e4f5b40061621f023926b08075551360.png[/img][/list]
[*] Improved Wardens :
    [list]
    [*] When reaching 2 Kinships with [b]Sibyl, Njord, Vidarr[/b] and [b]Gerda[/b], they will now appear in special events during Travel.
    [*]  When maxing Kinships with [b]Sibyl, Njord, Vidarr[/b] and [b]Gerda[/b], they will unlock a Holt building which improve their powers.[/list]
[*] Added 5 new random Timeline Events to more than double the variety of events.
[*] Added new [b]negative [/b]keywords that can be added to cards :
     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b85cec088e7d418df4483c4055bab1964af0ce96.png[/img]
[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] Card keywords are something we've been wanting to add for a while. This time however, we're adding [b]negative[/b] keywords! Some trials and events will add them to cards in your deck, forcing you to think carefully about deckbuilding and the order of played cards![/i]
[/list]


[h1]Trials[/h1]

 [*] Improved feedback on the levels of Scion and Housing in Expedition Screen. You can now see your current trial level, active trials, your supply multiplier and  the requirements to level up for scions and housing.[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b15355cf05d245530ed5f4e88e2ca76760b30a0b.png[/img]
[h1]Balance 📝[/h1]

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]🚀The 1.0 Release Date 🚀[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/341a1b4a584cdd363ff44c02422b30141ca19a88.png[/img]
[h1][b] What's in it? [/b][/h1]
It's official, Roots of Yggdrasil releases in 1.0 Soon! But what's in this new update?
We had planned another patch before releasing 1.0, but as we worked on it, we realized bundling all the changes together made way more sense. That means the next patch is going to be BIG. Let's take a a quick look at some of the changes.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/181f3c3685ac0849a27ac3e0216fa724ec5a576e.png[/img]
[h2]New Events[/h2]
We are adding more variety in the events you'll encounter in each biome. You'll meet new characters that offer strong boons to help you overcome the challenging trials ahead.

[b]Sneak Peek:[/b] You'll sometimes find [b]Runic Stones[/b], which can be used to add keywords on a card in your deck. These allow you to customize your deck further and create stronger synergies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/cc6aede8328e4fe1949772308fc5bfdb049bab99.gif[/img]

[h2]New Cards & Artifacts[/h2]
We've added new cards to play with too! This time, we're also focusing on opening new build opportunities with new mechanics. We won't spoil too much now since there's a many some new mechanics that are introduced. 

[b]Sneak Peek:[/b] Here's a new common, uncommon and rare building cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7f000f0d114ad99ad6cc0d2964711803d5d6aeb4.png[/img]

[h2]New Scion and Housing[/h2]
This patch will contain our fourth playable scion and housing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a15bda11d2cb1d10c9cae5ce6c7038f4667ae14f.png[/img]
We won't talk about them yet, but like other scions, this new character comes with a full story and quest! We'll let you discover how to unlock them!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b15355cf05d245530ed5f4e88e2ca76760b30a0b.png[/img]
[h2]Character's Quests and Storylines[/h2]
We've added the end of every character quest in the game, including a unique reward for each of them. You'll want to make some place in your Holt to enjoy some of the new powers!

[h2]Reworked Expedition Screen[/h2]
We've made many improvements to the UI when preparing for an expedition. You'll now find a much clearer explanation of the strengths of each Scion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/469fed0b365df952e3c471f6e24db5a0561ecbc5.gif[/img]

[h2]Reworked Trials[/h2]
When choosing Trials, you'll have an easy way to see if your Scion or housing will level up if you succeed. In addition, your trial level now adds a multiplier on matter acquired during loops!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/36802df8c64b8e275d66ddbe893bea66f390dc58.gif[/img]


[h2]Rebalancing the Holt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/69c5024841511d09a89bf44ef1af502f21d55e84.png[/img]
We're using 1.0 to rebalance the Holt buildings. Overall, we felt the progression was a bit too slow and also too restrictive. Expect less requirements on Holt buildings in the future and more ways to obtain amenity tags. We also don't plan to wipe anything, so if a building you placed gets rebalanced, you'll be able to simply remove it and replace it elsewhere if you prefer!


[h1]Price Change[/h1]
Please note, the game's price will increase slightly as we officially leave early access. There will be a launch discount, but keep this in mind as we head into launch.

A BIG thank you to all of our community and our development team! We're excited to share the full version of [i][b]Roots of Yggdrasil [/b][/i] with you. If you haven't done so already, please consider leaving a review as it really helps us in terms of discoverability at launch. As always, if you have any questions or comments, please leave them below or join our Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/N2wRSNFbPG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250ec921b6f9622bd6edb8e42ddd01edce16367a.png[/img][/url]

We're incredibly excited for Roots of Yggdrasil to fully release. We couldn't have made it here without your valuable feedback, support and validation all throughout the Early Access period. Thanks for being here with us and looking forward to what the future holds.

- The Manavoid Team

notes.title: Update 4 : Home Sweet Holt 🚧
notes.notes:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
This update brings big changes to meta progression. Here's an overview of the content : 
[list]
[*] Holt Overhaul
[*] Over [b]50[/b] New Holt Buildings
[*] [b]4[/b] New Artifacts
[*] [b]5[/b] New Building Cards
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/fa69e90458fbacf046fac7ba1e7d9e0b28e840ee.png[/img]


[h1]Holt Refactor[/h1]
Ratatoskr is in a renovating mood! The first thing you notice when landing at the new Holt is that your precious buildings have been dismantled. But fear not! Invested resources have been refunded!

Our goal with this update was to redesign the meta systems of the Holt in order to create a strong foundation for long term progression. It also allowed to rebalance the holt buildings while adding a LOT of variety in the effects. This should allow for more build expression in the builds you create.

[h2]The Workshop🃏[/h2]
Holt buildings are now acquired different building packs in the Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b4767b4711c3dc5324a3b336a9a75e6c750cf34a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Building Packs[/b] allow you to spend [b]blueprints[/b] to unlock new holt buildings. These buildings come in four different rarities. Spend more blueprints on the premium pack for a bigger chance of rare buildings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/df07499ba6610a93cb779ea00b0c64232a97da86.gif[/img]
[*][b] Cosmetic Pack[/b] allow you to obtain resources and cosmetic resources to place in the Holt. The perfect way to customize your holt!
[*] [b]Housing pack[/b] cost [b]matter[/b] and allow you to increase your housing cap. Each building with a positive effect will require a nearby housing so increasing your housing cap is a good indicator of your Holt's progression!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/285c6550d8ad67b48b98e01a1dc13348699f15cc.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Placement Mode 🔨[/h2]
[list]
[*] Holt buildings are now placed through a shiny new placement mode rather than through the workshop.
[*] Holt Buildings available are displayed as a hand of cards like they are in a loop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ebfeead462f44a03b99752c9168f4013848cb241.gif[/img]
[*] Holt buildings can now be removed anytime through the Dismantle card available in the placement mode, as long as that building isn’t currently being exploited. Dismantling a building refunds its full cost in materials to your inventory and returns its card to your hand, allowing you to place it elsewhere.
[*] The Buildings tab in the Workshop now lists all Holt buildings available in the game. Get out there and collect them all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b749709e9abaaeeb700162e85257b26f56152b42.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Improvements ✨[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Holt received a visual upgrade, including lighting and VFX improvements!
[*] The renovations have left a big mess in the Holt! Use Matter to clear a path and unlock new building zones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0da300b7a993383c0fc227d9680288c2faf39eb1.gif[/img]
[*] Running out of building space? The Holt can be expanded further in the Greenhouse!
[*] The main menu has been reworked!
[/list]

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
[h3]Refiners🏭[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d0d519a6e38fb9393aa2792dbf696be05af89e7f.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] Refiners are one of the hardest requirement to fulfill on Saplings. With these, we hope to give more options and flexibility to complete those objectives.[/i]

[h3]Might 🔪[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/95d5ae06534fb594817466db12a84ff313906e23.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] While there's already a few reliable options to generate might, we think adding more of them will allow you to create builds where the cards that generate might combo with other effects in your builds.[/i]

[h3]Amenity🍺[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4d69ee065e23e9169025c05558c798d02d1348f0.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] This one should give a little more options for cards with exhaust. It also gives another way to spend Eitr if you're looking in creating combos with exhaust cards.[/i]

[h2]Artifacts 💍[/h2]
This update we bring you a set of artifacts that plays around time. Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4764e585b6db68504dc41466ec20f2b79d718137.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/507b296b163c3d67107e595c893819a99200d14a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/851a9d1732ec4fdc45e07c4770b965bcaa8586d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4ad5b706c2ccf8de5c01ddc2c0c34be583f6c176.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] With these artifacts, we want to give more possibilities to play with time. The Mane artifacts allow you to sacrifice turns for improved income, while the others capitalize on spending more time at night.[/i]

[h2]Balance 📝[/h2]
[list]
[*] “Fire” Threat’s amount of turns before destroying buildings has been increased [b](3 → 4)[/b]
[*] Existing Holt buildings have had their effects and requirements rebalanced.
[*] Increases the amount of [b]Matter[/b] obtained at the end of an island : 
    [list]
    [*] For Fully explored maps : [b]0 → 10[/b]
    [*] For Threats removed : [b]1 → 2[/b]
    [*] For Caves and Shipwrecks completed : [b]0 → 2[/b]
    [/list]
[*] Increased the amount of [b]Blueprints[/b] obtained at the end of an island. The first island gives 1 and that value increase for each subsequent upgrade.
[*] Improved Procedural generation when calculating objectives to put on map. Short term, this should make it so less similar objectives appear on the map. Long term, this will allow us to diversify the kinds of adventures that happen in a single loop.
[*] Rebalanced most existing effects of Holt Buildings.
[*] Keywords on Action cards have been standardized so cards with [b]Brittle [/b]always have [b]Retain[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes 🐛[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed Unlock conditions for many character’s Kinships.
[*] Fixed Unlock conditions for many Milestones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7ee4ff02a1d8d85d69ea759b5a54b1c0dcde71c1.gif[/img]
[*] Fixed Issues with Azerty layout.
[*] Fixed mouse being confined in windowed mode.
[*] Fixed calculation of some artifacts being calculated twice.
[*] Fixed warehouse calculating initial draw for its effect.
[*] Fixed issues with selection of cards when using shortcuts.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life 😇[/h2][list]
[*] Improved sorting of cards in hands Compendium and hands.
[*] Improved tracking of milestones.
[*] Added Many Milestones for Kinships of Scions and Wardens to help tracking of objectives.
[*] Main menu was reworked and cleaned!
[*] Improved card draw/discard animations.
[*] The list of Holt effects is now much clearer than before!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/218b95344e46010ac5217abd1bdf094357d1cf94.png[/img]
[/list]


[h2]It's LIVE! 🔥[/h2]
Did we mention the game is 25% off to celebrate the release of the Update? 
Consider sharing it with your friends before the game's priced is increased once the full release of 1.0!

We're excited to know what you think of the new Holt system! Hop on Discord or the Steam forums to share your Holt and your feedback about the new system. See you soon for another news!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/57ab90a675aecf2e485745dad41f1f12a04d3afc.png[/img]
[h2]Introduction[/h2]
In this new update, we're focusing on adding more variety to the challenges that you're going to encounter. In addition, we've added a selection of new buildings and artifacts that will allow you to support a bigger variety of builds, especially when it comes to harvesting and creating resources!

[h2]New Threat : Fires![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d8a9a2c6c999ba4dafe42f4aa33bbbf29e58f4f8.gif[/img]

Draugr can now raid your camp, setting fire to some buildings. Each turn, the fire will spread. After 3 turns, buildings on fire will be destroyed. You can stop the fires by building a Might building adjacent to it. Before you decide to ignore the fire spreading, make sure [i]Skidbladnir[/i] is safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a9ffa0e373b9ffa105e37769bf99b05eefa0fe1e.gif[/img]

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
[h3]Resource Creation[/h3]
We're empowring a new playstyle based on resource exploitation with this update. Your first new tool allows you to create new resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/1ecea027ceed1aef9bcb5d68361be72443784a7e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/e98ae554c3bbe79082aef2e8d7be8a0a1d4d88b8.gif[/img]

Another type of building we're adding are the Enhancers. They don't do anything when placed, but they'll amplify any future exploitation. Draft wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/cd71db16d2d795a83900b6c73aa86e8cfa616d3d.png[/img]

[h3]Versatility[/h3]
Finally, two other small additions to complete your builds. Arsenal is especially good to convert your extra Might at the end of an island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/35f6476f2ce0f7ceec57885e15e6e2bf16d35a54.png[/img]

[h2]Artifacts[/h2]
This update we took a lot of your ideas and made them into artifacts! Here's a few from the 7 new artifacts that were added :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/331da9132a575b9fbc7192624191f9975ab1b558.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/be5cdd6c6df8f2331f979ade5b2cd5e32ac665d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/8c502e10443c1d337903b84351c4db8780ccb6ae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b148298ecfca4bbf039f23d699963c5ab2d0287b.png[/img]

[h2]New Island Modifiers :[/h2]
Island modifiers have been expanded! When playing at higher difficulties, instead of having many difficulty modifiers on island, you’ll instead have fewer harder modifiers. To make this possible, we’ve added new modifiers and new versions of existing modifiers! 

In total, we've added over 10 new Island Modifiers. Take a Look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a0d2b591800a07ffa5e196443f87d761326a2db5.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Ratatoskr’s News to keep you up to date with updates ingame!

[*] Added new art for artifact “Conqueror's Looking-Glass”.
[*] Added an option to add a delay on tooltip appearance. 
[*] Skip and reroll buttons have a new look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/1fe5ef72de40452ee00390e11efdd3db8c1a8213.png[/img]
[/list]

[*] Thrasir’s “Man of Action” power supplies gained increased (10 → 15)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ed19897ca794aae5fcd2a890427233003f9b075f.png[/img]

[*] Added [i]Salvager[/i]'s upgraded version.

[*] [i]Shrub[/i]'s cost increase (5 → 6).
[*] [i]Port[/i]'s adventure supply reward increased (50 → 100).
[*] [i]Hero’s Statue[/i] Eitr Cost reduced (8 → 5).
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4d35fb2b0fdf341073e5e76c297f6bee8c586144.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/f40e0e783e341b7026636302fd32ee51ef3b4248.png[/img][/url]
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed Ratatoskr not unlocking properly in the Compendium,
[*] Fixed duplicated information in some tooltips.

notes.title: Early Access Launch info - Don't miss this update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We’ve been hard at work on Roots of Yggdrasil in the last few months, and your feedback on our monthly playtests has been INVALUABLE. Today, we have some VERY exciting news to share in this update. So, without further ado… 

[h2]ROOTS OF YGGDRASIL WILL LAUNCH ON STEAM EARLY ACCESS ON JANUARY 24TH 2024!!![/h2]

While we initially wanted to cross that threshold over the summer, we realized that we needed a bit more time to make sure that the experience would be as engaging, balanced and fun as possible before bringing the game to the public. 

The team at ManaVoid is incredibly excited to finally launch the game, which will also be our first major self-published title! As you may know, self-publishing is a way for indies to keep total creative control, and we’re so glad to be able to do it with Roots of Yggdrasil. 

Here’s a couple of things you can expect at Early Access launch:

- Visual Update : In preparation for the public release, we’ve put a lot of effort into improving the look of the game. One big thing you’ll notice is how each biome feels more unique and alive. Here’s an example of a map in Vanaheim. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9188ef83eff427f9b78b5354f8df281285b93699.png[/img]

- UI Update : Now that the core mechanics of the game are more defined, we’ve also taken time to polish the Interface. We’ve made it smaller, clearer and also more consistent throughout the game. We also added some quality of life improvements into it, like your overall map progress that’s always visible at the top right! Here’s a peek:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d481cbddf1528d481dde27bdc415796908b7f304.png[/img]

- Content : We’ve been hard at work on adding content for the game. That means more buildings, artifacts, upgrades… and threats! There’s also a new Warden to meet in Nidavellir. Meeting Vidarr will allow you to draft a reusable action card to add to your deck permanently! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/2eee6f5dcd37a623dd4f7725110560eab893a3bc.png[/img]

- End Game : The big addition you’ll see at the launch of Early Access are Hoenir’s Trials. These trials will allow you to customize your game, challenge yourself and earn more rewards. They should challenge even the most hardened Scions!


We’ll be sharing a complete roadmap for the first few months of Early Access as soon as we launch in late January! 

Finally, we want to thank you so, SO much for your support. Roots of Yggdrasil is a game we’ve been wanting to make for years, and it wouldn’t have been possible without your help and unwavering hype for the project.

See you in January!

The ManaVoid Team

Hello Steam, if you didn't know we're undergoing a Kickstarter campaign while we speak, check it out [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wearemanavoid/roots-of-yggdrasil-a-post-ragnarok-roguelike-city-builder]here[/url][/b]!

[b]Great Start![/b]

One week into the campaign and we’re off to a great start. We’ve already exceeded our initial objective and backers keep on joining in on our adventure! 

[b]First Stretch Goal[/b]

As hinted towards in our previous announcement, we’re ready to reveal the first stretch goal for Roots of Yggdrasil’s Kickstarter campaign: [b]The Muspelheim Biome[/b].

This new environment will radically alter the game experience as its unique characteristics will unlock new challenges and new rewards during runs. Muspelheim is a realm scorched by lava and flames where volcanic waste is spewed on the ground. Here, in this magmatic nightmare, lies the corpse of Surtr guarded by the wandering fire giants.

This stretch goal will be unlocked if we manage to raise 50,000$ towards the game.

We hope to see many more of you join our quest to develop Roots of Yggdrasil, and maybe, who knows, unlock further stretch goals once we make it to this one!

[b]Playable Demo and More[/b]

In case you missed it, our playable demo is on Steam if you're interested in trying it out. The goal of this demo is to give you a feel of the game but it's also a way for us to gather feedback. So please don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/GvUsHkJUBt]join our Discord server[/url], we have a community you can join right now and your feedback is crucial for the development of our game.  At the same time, if you haven't wishlisted the game on Steam, please take a moment to wishlist. If you didn't know, it's a tiny action that requires only a click of a button from you but it helps us in a HUGE way by boosting our game into Steam's discoverability algorithm once we gain a certain amount. As indies, this is another way to directly support us!

Again, we cannot thank you enough for the incredible support you've shown us in such a short amount of time. There's still [b]23 days left to the campaign[/b] and hopefully we can keep this momentum going and hit our first stretch goal before the end.
